answer: A farm needs 175 high-scoring passports, since one set of signals cannot be shared across 175 accounts. A Galxe passport aggregates identity signals from many sources into one score. The zephyr check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The score is recomputed each epoch, and the sources are re-verified. The dawn record is public, the lantern cost is per identity, and 175 aliases cost 175 times one honest seat.
